description: The places and people of a business (C200), the administration side: what its bookings use. kind "sites" (a place: { name, timeZone?, address?, hours? }), "resources" (a group of identical units: { name, site?, count (how many: 30 tables, 200 spaces; 1), capacity (how many fit in one; 1), hours? }) and "staff" (the professionals: { name, email?, sites? ([ids] where they work), hours? }). hours: { timeZone?, week: { MO: ["09:00-14:00", "16:00-20:00"], … } (a day left out is closed; a professional's range can say where: { from, to, site }), closed?: ["2026-12-25"] }; none: always open. action "list" { kind }, "save" { kind, id?, …fields } (makes one, or changes the one with that id: only the fields given), "remove" { kind, id } (refused with in_use while a session to come or a service uses it). "accounts" { from?, to? } (this month by default): per professional, site and resource, the sessions, minutes and people, to pay them outside Neblla; and the notes written by hand with their total per who. "agenda" { from, to } (at most 62 days): every service's sessions in that time, each with its set, who booked, its places and its state (confirmed, proposed, cancelled), as a calendar shows them. "note" { who ("staff:<id>", "site:<id>" or a name), amount (cents: what the business owes them, negative when it paid), date?, note? }, "notes" { from?, to?, who? }, "removeNote" { id }. Closures (holidays, a room under repair, a professional away, a server's maintenance): "close" { kind? ("sites", "resources", "staff"; left out: the whole business), id?, from, to?, reason?, timeZone? } — from and to are dates ("2026-10-29": that whole day, to is the last day closed) in the zone of the place (or timeZone, else UTC), or ISO times; every session it reaches that has not started is cancelled as the business cancelling it (what was paid with credits or at booking comes back; a case of a standing place does not, unless the service has recoverStanding: true), the cases of a repetition made later on those days are made cancelled, and opening, moving or booking a session in it answers "busy" (what: "closed"). Clients see the cancelled sessions in slots() with the reason, and the closures with neblla.business.booking.closures(). "closures" { from?, to? } lists them (from now on), "reopen" { closure } takes one away: the sessions it cancelled that had nobody booked open again. A client's card: "userBookings" { user } (the user id in the app: their bookings of every service, upcoming and past), "userNotes" { user } (the business's private notes about them, never shown to them), "userNote" { user, text }, "removeUserNote" { id }. Businesses that apply from the app (C351: clubs in a padel app, coworkings in a network), with neblla_update_app({ business: { apply: { fields?: [{ key, label, type ("text", "number", "boolean"), required? }], group? (the id of a group of neblla_team whose rights the new site's group copies; none: Business to write) } } }) and neblla.business.apply() in the app: "applications" { status? ("pending" by default, "approved", "rejected", "all"; the oldest first, with the applicant's name and email) }, "approve" { application } (makes the site with what they wrote, a group of the team limited to it with the template's rights, and invites the applicant to the team with their Neblla account; they hear it in on('update')), "reject" { application, reason? } (nothing is deleted; they read the reason and can apply again). Sites also take phone?, about?, photo? (https) and fields? (the answers to the app's own questions); neblla.business.booking.services() gives them to the app, with rating and ratingCount. Ratings both ways after a session already played (C356): clients rate the site with neblla.business.rate(); "rateUser" { user, slot, rating (1-5), text? } is the business rating a client of that session (once per session; again changes it), "userRating" { user } their average and what the businesses said (only the businesses see it; the agenda brings clientRating on each booking), "reviews" { kind? ("sites", the default, or "users"), id? (a site, or a user), hidden? } to moderate them, newest first, and "hideReview" { review, hidden? } hides one (it stays, counts for nothing and nobody reads it; hidden: false shows it again). Sessions are made with neblla_booking createSlot (site, staff, resource); a service names the resources and staff it needs in its set (neblla_update_app business.booking). EACH SELLER PAID WHAT IS THEIRS (C400): an app with many sellers (the clubs of a padel app, the artists of a gallery, the authors of a shop, the teachers of a platform) charges each sale on the seller's OWN Stripe account, which pays its refunds and disputes (never Neblla nor the developer); the developer takes a commission, neblla_update_app({ business: { sellers: { fee: { percent?, fixed? (cents) } } } }), paid to their payout account once Stripe makes it available. A product names its seller (neblla_create_product seller), and a service paid at booking says seller: "site" (the site of each session: the club whose court it is) or one seller, in its set. "sellers" (each with status not_connected | pending | restricted | active, ready, requirementsDue; and the commission), "addSeller" { seller, name? } (a site of the business: "site:<id>", or a user of the app: "user:<id>"), "removeSeller" { seller } (their Stripe stays theirs), "sellerStatus" { seller } (asks Stripe again), "sellerLink" { seller } (Stripe's onboarding, for the seller to open right now). The seller links it themselves from the app too: neblla.business.sellers.mine() and neblla.business.sellers.connect({ seller }) (a user seller is themself; a site, the user whose application made it). Until a seller's account is active, what they sell waits (seller_waiting). Reselling between users is not there.

env.description: "pro" (the published app) or "pre" (its test copy: pre's config, on pre's data, its own unless it plays with pro's). Left out: where the app is, its chosen environment (neblla_promote "status": target, "pro" by default). The pre id (_<id>) as appId is the same as env "pre"

hidden.description: reviews: only the hidden (true) or the shown (false); hideReview: false shows it again

seller.description: addSeller, removeSeller, sellerStatus, sellerLink: "site:<site id>" or "user:<user id>"

slot.description: rateUser: the session they were in

user.description: The user id in the app (userBookings, userNotes, userNote)
